name: cover-detail
text: Customer journey, business logic, security, persistence and administration
textPreview: Customer journey, business logic, security, persistence and administration

name: title-2
text: One connected journey, with the server as the source of truth
textPreview: One connected journey, with the server as the source of truth

name: problem-text-1
text: Shopping actions are often fragmented across discovery, saved intent, cart and payment.
textPreview: Shopping actions are often fragmented across discovery, saved intent, cart and payment.

name: problem-text-2
text: Browser values cannot be trusted for identity, stock, totals or payment success.
textPreview: Browser values cannot be trusted for identity, stock, totals or payment success.

name: problem-text-3
text: Administrators need controlled catalogue and user-cart visibility without exposing customer operations.
textPreview: Administrators need controlled catalogue and user-cart visibility without exposing customer operations.

name: problem-text-4
text: The project needs a traceable path from one click to durable database state and back.
textPreview: The project needs a traceable path from one click to durable database state and back.

name: solution-copy
text: A JWT-secured React SPA backed by transactional Spring services and relational persistence.
textPreview: A JWT-secured React SPA backed by transactional Spring services and relational persistence.

name: title-3
text: A modular monolith with clear request and data boundaries
textPreview: A modular monolith with clear request and data boundaries

name: arch-points-text-1
text: Controller → service → repository separation keeps transport, business rules and persistence distinct.
textPreview: Controller → service → repository separation keeps transport, business rules and persistence distinct.

name: arch-points-text-2
text: DTO validation defines API contracts; MySQL constraints remain the final integrity boundary.
textPreview: DTO validation defines API contracts; MySQL constraints remain the final integrity boundary.

name: arch-points-text-3
text: React owns interaction state; the backend owns roles, stock, totals, payment status and durable records.
textPreview: React owns interaction state; the backend owns roles, stock, totals, payment status and durable records.

name: title-4
text: Authentication is stateless; authorization remains server-enforced
textPreview: Authentication is stateless; authorization remains server-enforced

name: auth-text-1
text: Axios attaches the Bearer token; JwtFilter validates signature and expiry before protected controllers.
textPreview: Axios attaches the Bearer token; JwtFilter validates signature and expiry before protected controllers.

name: auth-text-2
text: The current role is reloaded from MySQL as ROLE_USER or ROLE_ADMIN on every authenticated request.
textPreview: The current role is reloaded from MySQL as ROLE_USER or ROLE_ADMIN on every authenticated request.

name: auth-text-3
text: Forgot-password stores only a SHA-256 token digest, expires after 30 minutes and is single-use.
textPreview: Forgot-password stores only a SHA-256 token digest, expires after 30 minutes and is single-use.

name: auth-text-4
text: Profile email changes issue a new JWT because the token subject is the user's email.
textPreview: Profile email changes issue a new JWT because the token subject is the user's email.

name: auth-note-copy
text: Frontend route guards improve UX; Spring Security is the real access-control boundary.
textPreview: Frontend route guards improve UX; Spring Security is the real access-control boundary.

name: title-5
text: Active catalogue data is enriched with stock and review aggregates
textPreview: Active catalogue data is enriched with stock and review aggregates

name: catalog-text-1
text: Customer queries return only products where active = true.
textPreview: Customer queries return only products where active = true.

name: catalog-text-2
text: Search supports keyword, category, both, or neither through one endpoint.
textPreview: Search supports keyword, category, both, or neither through one endpoint.

name: catalog-text-3
text: ProductResponse adds averageRating and reviewCount without exposing JPA entities.
textPreview: ProductResponse adds averageRating and reviewCount without exposing JPA entities.

name: catalog-text-4
text: The detail screen loads product and reviews concurrently and caps quantity at current stock.
textPreview: The detail screen loads product and reviews concurrently and caps quantity at current stock.

name: catalog-text-5
text: Soft deletion preserves cart, review and order references while hiding the item from customers.
textPreview: Soft deletion preserves cart, review and order references while hiding the item from customers.

name: title-6
text: Saved intent and customer feedback are account-linked, persistent features
textPreview: Saved intent and customer feedback are account-linked, persistent features

name: engagement-body-0
text: Heart toggles immediately; failure restores the previous Set.
textPreview: Heart toggles immediately; failure restores the previous Set.

name: engagement-body-1
text: One wishlist and one review row per user-product pair.
textPreview: One wishlist and one review row per user-product pair.

name: engagement-body-2
text: Submitting again updates rating, comment and optional image.
textPreview: Submitting again updates rating, comment and optional image.

name: engagement-body-3
text: UUID image storage plus average/count refresh.
textPreview: UUID image storage plus average/count refresh.

name: title-7
text: A persistent, user-owned aggregate bridges discovery and checkout
textPreview: A persistent, user-owned aggregate bridges discovery and checkout

name: cart-principle-copy
text: The authenticated user's cart—not a userId in the payload—defines ownership.
textPreview: The authenticated user's cart—not a userId in the payload—defines ownership.

name: cart-text-1
text: One cart per user is created lazily on the first read or add.
textPreview: One cart per user is created lazily on the first read or add.

name: cart-text-2
text: Repeated adds merge quantity and preserve the add-time unit-price snapshot.
textPreview: Repeated adds merge quantity and preserve the add-time unit-price snapshot.

name: cart-text-3
text: Update and delete verify that the cartItem belongs to the current user's cart.
textPreview: Update and delete verify that the cartItem belongs to the current user's cart.

name: cart-text-4
text: Active state and stock are checked on add/update; quantity ≤ 0 removes the line.
textPreview: Active state and stock are checked on add/update; quantity ≤ 0 removes the line.

name: cart-text-5
text: The UI previews GST, but checkout recalculates the authoritative total.
textPreview: The UI previews GST, but checkout recalculates the authoritative total.

name: title-8
text: Order creation locks stock, snapshots history and verifies online payment server-side
textPreview: Order creation locks stock, snapshots history and verifies online payment server-side

name: checkout-text-1
text: @Transactional keeps stock decrement, order snapshots and cart clearing atomic.
textPreview: @Transactional keeps stock decrement, order snapshots and cart clearing atomic.

name: checkout-text-2
text: PESSIMISTIC_WRITE product locks prevent concurrent overselling.
textPreview: PESSIMISTIC_WRITE product locks prevent concurrent overselling.

name: checkout-text-3
text: BigDecimal calculates subtotal + 18% GST + free delivery on the server.
textPreview: BigDecimal calculates subtotal + 18% GST + free delivery on the server.

name: checkout-text-4
text: COD creates PENDING_COD; online creates PAYMENT_PENDING then verifies the Razorpay signature.
textPreview: COD creates PENDING_COD; online creates PAYMENT_PENDING then verifies the Razorpay signature.

name: checkout-text-5
text: Current limitation: cancelled online payment keeps the pending order and reserved stock.
textPreview: Current limitation: cancelled online payment keeps the pending order and reserved stock.

name: title-9
text: Operational control is separated from the customer experience
textPreview: Operational control is separated from the customer experience

name: admin-text-2
text: Create, update, deactivate and reactivate catalogue items.
textPreview: Create, update, deactivate and reactivate catalogue items.

name: admin-text-3
text: List users while blocking deletion of ADMIN accounts.
textPreview: List users while blocking deletion of ADMIN accounts.

name: admin-text-4
text: Inspect user carts without exposing a customer-side control path.
textPreview: Inspect user carts without exposing a customer-side control path.

name: admin-text-5
text: Product removal is soft deletion: active becomes false.
textPreview: Product removal is soft deletion: active becomes false.

name: title-10
text: Eight tables protect ownership, uniqueness and historical order state
textPreview: Eight tables protect ownership, uniqueness and historical order state

name: db-text-1
text: Unique email, one cart per user, and unique user-product wishlist/review pairs.
textPreview: Unique email, one cart per user, and unique user-product wishlist/review pairs.

name: db-text-2
text: Foreign keys connect every commerce operation to a valid user and product.
textPreview: Foreign keys connect every commerce operation to a valid user and product.

name: db-text-3
text: Cart item price and order item fields preserve commercial snapshots.
textPreview: Cart item price and order item fields preserve commercial snapshots.

name: db-text-4
text: Checkout locks product rows and commits stock, order and cart changes together.
textPreview: Checkout locks product rows and commits stock, order and cart changes together.

name: db-text-5
text: Response DTOs return safe, purpose-specific JSON instead of entity graphs.
textPreview: Response DTOs return safe, purpose-specific JSON instead of entity graphs.

name: title-11
text: Each presenter owns one vertical slice and its cross-module dependencies
textPreview: Each presenter owns one vertical slice and its cross-module dependencies

name: closing-copy
text: One user action remains traceable from React to MySQL—and back to the UI.
textPreview: One user action remains traceable from React to MySQL—and back to the UI.
